pull_requests.title: ACCEL02: reflected native massive moments for the reusable split-stress pilot
pull_requests.body:
## Why
The completed warm C15 pilot already has 729 reusable cases. For a new geometry, the massive Vlasov moment evaluator repeats the same even angular kernel at mirrored nodes. This change reduces that duplicate work while retaining the existing 96×32 quadrature and independent matter/radiation stresses.

## Changes
- Fuse the three massive moments in an optional C++17 kernel, folding the original 32 angular nodes into 16 reflected pairs and using Neumaier compensated accumulation.
- Connect an explicit compiler receipt, immutable per-model inputs and the existing exact cache through an optional worker backend.
- Preserve the original pilot, solver, gates, case planner and shared resource-aware executor. Completed729 returns no-work before native build/load.
- Supply theory, frozen acceptance contract, raw checks, independent review, NCP commands and next-thread/restore handoffs.
- Surveyed all 871 accessible branch refs across four repositories and relevant conversations/backups first. Newly recovered C21M98 results remain a separate physical lineage.

## Verification and scoped decision
PASS_SCOPED_LOCAL_NUMERICAL_EQUIVALENCE; fresh independent review: zero blocking findings and zero repairs.
- 140 kernel points: max |delta J|/J0 = 3.0017696087628955e-16, below frozen 64 eps64.
- Three derivative probes: max normalized residual 3.730718793634552e-12, below 2e-9.
- Five original/native pairs, two steps each: all original eight gates passed on ten trajectories.
- Nine existing dispatcher tests passed. One actual native worker solve then same-case reuse passed.
- One compile, eleven tiny trajectory solves in total, zero benchmarks and zero full729 reruns.

## Delivery and NCP
Stage A/B were published in both repositories and their Dropbox object sizes verified. Stage C's 5,514,078-byte standalone restore archive was downloaded once and passed SHA256, Dropbox content hash, CRC and exact 263-entry verification.
Archive SHA256: 7e19cbf24218e91140e0e85cff6b3d70535763c14ff86d86fbc81a946387ec0f.
Actual receipts and DAG are under research/rei_sigma_pi_native_moments_20261021/delivery.

Runnable source pins: REI 231df3ab717dbc112f63b77953f64def08e9bcb5; BASS 7fe0e25a28c0e48110c522378e203ffb934cc504. Later commits add review and delivery records without source changes.
Local environment was 8 CPU / 8 GiB. NCP 64 CPU / 128 GiB is the target ceiling; live NCP resources and native execution remain unobserved in this session. The handoff compiles once on target and admits only pending work against real shared resources, with numerical threads set to one.

## Limits
3072→1536 is the energy/sqrt evaluation-point count per cache miss, not a measured end-to-end speedup. Acceptance covers the fixed kernel points and short warm a=0.1999→0.2 checks. Full EoR, non-LRS, full Q^a closure, convergence and generalized new-grid aggregation remain separate obligations. This PR remains draft and is not merged.
